# Legacy Office fixtures

All fixtures are distributable test data; see the evaluation report for the qualification status. They are not production attachment samples.

Bounded drawing records are accepted but never exposed. |

The LibreOffice sources are project-authored test data. The Writer fixture is a
positive semantic regression; the Calc fixture is a positive XLS fidelity
regression with bounded drawing-record coverage. They are the current
compatibility evidence; additional real-world producer samples are future coverage.
